35: He is not established as a denier — The Sma wrote that this is as long as he did not say before them "atem eidai" (you are my witnesses), etc. But to me it appears that it deals even with where he did say before them "atem eidai," only that it teaches us that they have not the status of a beis din, only the status of witnesses, regarding the point that he is not established as a denier going forward to say afterward "I paid you," as below in siman 79 se'if 9 — see there, and this is clear.
